specName: Ctrl rules and removing needed letters

decisions.decision: Layer C keyboard-lint check KM_LINT_RAW_CTRL plus upgrade pair in studio
decisions.why: matches existing criterion and upgrade seams

decisions.decision: Report raw Ctrl in any group; warn once per char per session
decisions.why: collision is group-independent; removal is the author's call

plan.summary: Plan: check, upgrade, no-new-Ctrl limits, removal warning; FR-005/007 stubbed
plan.key_finding: All pieces reuse existing seams (upgradePairs, carveNeededSet, criteria.json)

tasks.summary: 53 tasks across Foundational, US1-US4 and Polish; 3 waves of parallel work, one sequencing exception at T037

approach: Add a keyboard-lint raw-Ctrl check and advisory with criteria rows, an IR-splice upgrade returning characters to the inventory, gallery/touch limits against Ctrl, and a dismissable needed-letter warning reusing carveNeededSet.

FR-001.title: Outside basic_* keyboards, a rule on unsided CTRL (without Alt) on a letter, number or punctuation key is reported with a move-off-Ctrl recommendation and a may-not-be-accepted warning

FR-002.title: The fix removes those Ctrl rules by text splice and returns each typed character to the inventory as unplaced, without re-adding characters typed elsewhere

FR-003.title: No new Ctrl content or Ctrl layer on Copy or in the Open galleries; existing basic_* Ctrl content kept unless carved

FR-004.title: LCTRL and RCTRL allowed, with an advisory that an Alt-based placement is preferred

FR-005.title: Unsided CTRL ALT offered an RALT upgrade, withheld unless a before/after AltGr simulation matches (stub, awaiting owner)

FR-006.title: Removing a needed letter on Copy or Open shows a dismissable warning naming the languages that need it; composed and decomposed forms match

FR-007.title: basic_* touch ctrl and shift-ctrl layers may be renamed to rightalt and rightalt-shift (stub, awaiting owner)

FR-008.title: The criterion and advisory are criteria.json rows with keyboard-lint checks; the fixes are upgrade pairs

T001.did: Added KM_LINT_RAW_CTRL and KM_LINT_SIDED_CTRL_ADVISORY criteria rows

T002.did: Stub raw-Ctrl and sided-Ctrl checks registered in runner and index
